marks.gloss_en: now that a wick -- of which Ulla said one who lights must light most of what protrudes -- [needs a majority], slivers, is it even a question? so R' Yochanan's 'no majority needed' cannot be about slivers
[it is not the case that] Babylonian wood needs a majority to catch (stance deny: R' Yochanan -- it needs none)
[it is not the case that] the four bonfires -- of pitch, of sulphur, of cheese, of fat -- need a majority to catch (stance deny: they need none)
one may not light [the Shabbat lamp] with lekhesh
אמר ליה אביי: והכתיב והיה החסון לנעורת -- מכלל דחוסן לאו נעורת הוא (from a verse; kind svara under protest, see header). Unanswered: the text turns to אלא.
Rav Yosef: chosen is tow of flax
Rami bar Avin: tar is the refuse of pitch
Shmuel: I asked all the seafarers and they said: its name is kulka
שוכא דארזא עץ בעלמא הוא -- a cedar branch is mere wood!
בעמרניתא דאית ביה -- [it means] the woolly substance that is in it (= p_lekhesh_amranita)
lekhesh is the cedar branch
איבעית אימא: שירא לחוד ושירא פרנדא לחוד -- offered as an alternative after the concession תיובתא (= p_shira_lechud)
the baraita: [garments of] shira'im are obligated in tzitzit
Ravin, seeing Rabbana Nechemya wearing metaksa: this is the kalakh we learned
אמר ליה: ההיא עץ בעלמא הוא -- Abaye: that is mere wood!
קלף ואחוי ליה עמרניתא דביני ביני -- he peeled it and showed him the woolly substance in between (= p_idan_amranita)
'nor with a wick of idan' -- [idan is] achvina
the baraita: they added to them [wicks] of wool -- one may not light with them
(entertained) the green [growth] on the water is the dark growth of ditches
zefet [of the mishna] is zifta (pitch)
